gateAReason: This export packages evidence; it does not certify object presence. Gate A closes only when a reviewer confirms three genuine live ON/OFF trials from a real object and microphone.

object.name: Reference desk fan
object.description: A synthetic reference object used to exercise the complete Whirr metering and settlement loop. Its classifier is trained on generated audio, not on a physical fan.

notes: This is an enrollment-fit consistency guard. It is computed from the calibration takes, not a held-out identity classifier.
It can make active time uncertain; it can never turn idle or ambiguous time into billable time.
A similar or identical machine can share this spectral profile, and recorded playback is not detectable by a microphone.

The calibration separation is narrow. The gate is enabled because it retained active frames and rejected most non-active profiles, but it should be rechecked on real sessions and after any room or microphone change.

This passport is installation attestation: it proves this installation signed these bytes, not that a third party verified the object or the time.
The acoustic signature is a calibration-fit consistency check, not an anti-spoof or identity document.

This bundled model is trained on procedurally synthesised fixtures, not on a physical appliance. Its metrics demonstrate the pipeline only and must not be read as real-world accuracy.
The acoustic passport is a calibration-fit consistency check, not an anti-spoof or identity guarantee. A similar machine can share the same spectral shape.
Audio-only sensing cannot detect speaker playback of a previously recorded machine. Supervised venues are required.
Two identical machines running at the same time cannot be reliably distinguished by one microphone.
A renter-controlled phone or laptop cannot secure an unattended object; this system does not physically lock anything.
Tab suspension, sleep or microphone loss stops accrual, but creates an evidence gap that is not billed.
The classifier is trained on one object in one acoustic environment; it is not a universal appliance recogniser.

instructions: Open /verify-offline.html in a modern browser, or run npm run proof:verify -- <bundle.json>.
The verifier checks the ECDSA envelope, receipt arithmetic, nested proof and every Merkle inclusion proof.
Pin the installation key fingerprint out of band when the signer is known. Without a pin the key is self-attested.
Payment must be reconciled online with PayPal; an offline bundle cannot prove provider settlement.
verification.keyPinning: Optional: supply a trusted key ID. A bundle signed by a different key fails pinning even if its embedded signature is internally consistent.
